annotations.title: Full property storm history (2003-present, all perils)

description: The FULL real archive for one property: hail, wind, flood/heavy rain, lightning, and tornado, 2003 to present, in one report -- not the 365-day snapshot (use get_address_report for that). Free preview shows the real report-line count and exact price before anything is paid. Paid report is billed per real report line: $0.05/line, $10.00 minimum per report. Optional date_of_loss anchors the report around one specific date, returning the real weather events recorded on and immediately around it, for reference -- not a determination of whether any claim is valid. Address and date of loss are sent to the API in a POST body, which keeps them out of URLs and logs.

address.description: Street address. Real server-side geocoding -- no separate geocoding step needed.

addresses.description: false = free preview (line count + price). true = the real full report -- requires the user's own Atlas United Data API account key, or an x402 payment.

date_of_loss.description: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD. Anchors the report around this date.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles. Default 5, max 25.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment payload, used instead of an API key.
